annotations.title: Pre-transfer address check (format, checksum, network, memo)

description: Before sending crypto: detects the chain family (EVM, TRON, Bitcoin, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Solana, TON, XRP), verifies checksums, catches token-contract / burn addresses as recipients, invisible or look-alike characters, pasted tx hashes or private keys, testnet addresses and address / network mismatches (e.g. a 0x address on TRC-20); flags a missing memo / tag for exchange deposits. Verdict ok / caution / incomplete / do_not_send. PAID: $0.001 per call or 1 prepaid credits, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a credits key bought by a plain USDC transfer (credits_quote / credits_claim, then header Authorization: Bearer ssk_...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/address-check.

memo.description: Memo / destination tag you plan to include (TON, XRP, XLM, ...; max 100 chars)

network.description: Network you intend to send on. Aliases accepted: ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, bnb, trc20, solana, bitcoin, eip155:<id>. Omit to check format only.

recipient.description: Who receives: exchange deposit address, your own wallet, or someone else

name: check_crypto_address_before_sending
